raw_text: India's Chabahar Decision Signals New Era in Iran-India Strategic Relations. India's commitment to the Chabahar port development despite Western pressure represents a pivotal moment in Asian geopolitics. The agreement demonstrates that Iran remains an indispensable partner for India's regional connectivity ambitions. Analysts say the deal will strengthen the International North-South Transport Corridor and reduce India's dependence on routes controlled by rivals.
clean_text: Tehran Times frames Chabahar deal as pivotal moment positioning Iran as indispensable partner for India. Claims deal will reduce India's dependence on rival-controlled routes.
